说明: 配乐和音效都写在这里。时间写法：12.5 | a01（句子开始）| a01$（句子结束）| a01:关键词 | END（片尾卡）| DUR（全片结束），后面可以跟 +0.3 / -0.2。

groove.caption: A playful, confident instrumental beat for a fast-talking tech explainer: bouncy drums with a swung hi-hat, a plucky bass line, short muted guitar stabs, light marimba hits. Dry, tight, no vocals, leaves room for a narrator.

rise.caption: An energetic, uplifting electronic instrumental: driving four-on-the-floor drums, a bright arpeggiated synth, punchy bass, big chord stabs that keep building. No vocals.

outro.caption: A warm, relaxed instrumental ending: soft felt piano over an analog pad and a gentle bass, a few finger snaps. Calm and friendly, no vocals.
